name: Canada
timeAuthority: Each province and territory sets its own legal time by statute or regulation.

name: British Columbia
timeAuthority: Provincial legislature: Interpretation Act s. 26 ('Pacific Time' = UTC-7), brought into force by B.C. Reg. 20/2026. The 2019 plan to wait for Washington, Oregon and California was dropped.

name: Alberta
timeAuthority: Provincial legislature: Official Time Act, RSA 2000 c. O-5.7 (UTC-6, no DST), proclaimed by OC 204/2026.

name: Northwest Territories
timeAuthority: Territorial government by regulation under the Interpretation Act (Northwest Territories Time Regulations, R-090-2026).

name: Manitoba
timeAuthority: Provincial legislature: The Official Time Act (C.C.S.M. c. O30), amended by S.M. 2023 c. 4 with effect from 2026-10-31 by proclamation.

name: Saskatchewan
timeAuthority: Provincial legislature: The Time Act (RSS 1978 c. T-14); Bill 58, The Time Act, 2026 is assented but comes into force only by order of the Lieutenant Governor in Council.

name: Morocco
timeAuthority: Government by decree (Decree 2.18.855 of 2018, abrogated by Decree 2.26.530 published in BO 7521).

name: Western Sahara
timeAuthority: Moroccan legal-time decrees are applied in the Moroccan-administered territory; tzdata 2026c: the return to UTC "also affects Western Sahara".

name: Paraguay
timeAuthority: Congress by law (Ley No. 7354 of 2024: UTC-3 nationwide).

name: Kazakhstan
timeAuthority: Government resolution (19 Jan 2024: 5th time zone for the whole territory).

name: Greenland
timeAuthority: Inatsisartut (Greenland parliament) and Naalakkersuisut; standard time UTC-2 from 2023-03-25, EU DST rules from 2024.

name: Mexico
timeAuthority: Federal Congress: Ley de los Husos Horarios en los Estados Unidos Mexicanos (DOF 2022-10-28), with a northern-border seasonal regime on US dates.

name: Chihuahua
timeAuthority: Federal law; the state is on UTC-6 without DST except the border strip (Ciudad Juárez, Ojinaga), which follows US DST from 2022-11-30.

name: Baja California
timeAuthority: Federal law: northern-border seasonal time on US dates (2nd Sunday of March to 1st Sunday of November).

name: Egypt
timeAuthority: Parliament by law (Law No. 24 of 2023 reinstating DST: last Friday of April to last Thursday of October).

name: Haiti
timeAuthority: Presidency (annual notices; primary text not retrieved - UNVERIFIED).

name: Lebanon
timeAuthority: Council of Ministers (the 2023 postponement and its reversal were cabinet decisions).

name: Ukraine
timeAuthority: Cabinet of Ministers Resolution No. 509 (1996) governs time; bill 4201 (law No. 3856-IX) awaiting the President. Public holidays: Labour Code art. 73, suspended under martial law by Law 2136-IX art. 6(6).

calendarCoverage.note: Only the art. 73 dates relevant to the research cases (24 Aug, 1 Oct, 25 Dec 2026) plus the martial-law suspension window; the extension of martial law beyond 2026-10-31 is UNVERIFIED.

name: United States
timeAuthority: Congress: Uniform Time Act of 1966 (15 U.S.C. 260a) sets DST dates; states may exempt themselves. Federal holidays: 5 U.S.C. 6103 (federal employees only).

calendarCoverage.note: Only Juneteenth (observed Fri 2021-06-18).
Federal holidays for federal employees per OPM 2026 schedule; states and private employers differ.
Federal holidays per OPM 2027 schedule, plus Fri 2027-12-31 observed for New Year 2028 (OPM 2028 schedule).

name: Florida
timeAuthority: Fla. Stat. 1.025: year-round DST only if Congress amends 15 U.S.C. 260a to allow it.

calendarCoverage.note: Only Juneteenth (no paid day off for state workers per Pew 2026; Wyoming statute not fetched - UNVERIFIED).

name: Arizona
timeAuthority: State exemption from DST under 15 U.S.C. 260a(a).

name: Hawaii
timeAuthority: State exemption from DST under 15 U.S.C. 260a(a).

name: European Union
timeAuthority: Directive 2000/84/EC fixes summer-time dates for all Member States; the 2018 proposal to end clock changes (2018/0332(COD)) awaits the Council.

name: Germany
timeAuthority: National standard time; summer-time dates harmonised by EU Directive 2000/84/EC.

name: France
timeAuthority: National standard time; summer-time dates harmonised by EU Directive 2000/84/EC.

name: Spain
timeAuthority: National standard time; summer-time dates harmonised by EU Directive 2000/84/EC.

name: Greece
timeAuthority: National standard time; summer-time dates harmonised by EU Directive 2000/84/EC.

name: Portugal
timeAuthority: National standard time; summer-time dates harmonised by EU Directive 2000/84/EC.

name: Poland
timeAuthority: National standard time; summer-time dates harmonised by EU Directive 2000/84/EC. Public holidays: Act of 18 January 1951 on days off work (as amended by Dz.U. 2024 poz. 1965).

calendarCoverage.note: All statutory days off under the 1951 Act (13 holidays; Sundays via the weekend regime). Easter-dependent dates computed with the Gregorian computus.
1951 Act list plus 24 December (in force 2025-02-01). Easter-dependent dates computed.
1951 Act list plus 24 December. Easter-dependent dates computed.

name: Iran
timeAuthority: Parliament by law (DST cancelled from Iranian year 1402); in 2025 the government asked for authority to set DST - not granted.

name: Jordan
timeAuthority: Council of Ministers (decision of 2022-10-05: summer time all year, i.e. permanent UTC+3).

name: Syria
timeAuthority: Cabinet (decision of 2022-10-04: permanent UTC+3).

name: Chile
timeAuthority: Government by decree (DS 1.286 of 2018 as amended; mainland regime renewed by Decreto 98 of 2026 to fall 2029).

name: Aysén
timeAuthority: Decreto 93 (DO 2025-03-20): permanent UTC-3.

name: Magallanes y la Antártica Chilena
timeAuthority: Permanent UTC-3 since 2016-12-04 (tzdata); confirmed by Decreto 93 of 2025.

name: Moldova
timeAuthority: Government decision (2026, Monitorul Oficial) formalising EU transition times used in practice since 2022.

name: Brazil
timeAuthority: Federal executive by decree (Decreto 9.772/2019 ended DST). Holidays: federal law (e.g. Lei 14.759/2023); annual MGI ordinance for the federal administration.

calendarCoverage.note: Only 20 November.
Only 20 November.
National holidays and federal optional days per Portaria MGI 11.460/2025; state and municipal holidays not included.

timeAuthority: Bank holidays: Banking and Financial Dealings Act 1971; one-off days by Royal Proclamation under s. 1(3).

name: Russia
timeAuthority: Holidays: Labour Code art. 112; annual Government decree transferring days off.

calendarCoverage.note: Labour Code art. 112 holidays, Decree 1466 transfers and art. 112 part 2 weekend shifts (as listed by ConsultantPlus).
Only the Decree 1187 transfers and 23 February; automatic art. 112 shifts for 2027 not recorded.

name: China
timeAuthority: State Council: 全国年节及纪念日放假办法 (Decree 795) and the annual General Office notice on holiday arrangements.

calendarCoverage.note: All 2026 holiday blocks and six make-up working days per 国办发明电〔2025〕7号. Weekend dates inside blocks are rest days via the weekend regime.

name: United Arab Emirates
timeAuthority: Federal government (FAHR circulars) for the federal public sector; MoHRE for the private sector.

calendarCoverage.note: Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha 1447 holidays of the federal government (private-sector ranges differ: 19-22 Mar, 26-29 May).

name: Sharjah
timeAuthority: Government of Sharjah: four-day working week (Mon-Thu), Friday-Sunday weekend.

name: Saudi Arabia
timeAuthority: Royal decrees and HRSD announcements; Eid holidays anchored to the Umm al-Qura calendar and Supreme Court sightings.

calendarCoverage.note: Only the SAMA in-lieu Founding Day for banks (2025-02-23).
Founding Day, National Day and private-sector Eid holidays; weekly-rest compensation days and the government-sector Eid ranges are UNVERIFIED.

name: Japan
timeAuthority: National Holidays Act (Act No. 178 of 1948); Cabinet Office publishes the official list.

calendarCoverage.note: All rows of the Cabinet Office CSV for 2021 (Olympic moves included).
All rows of the Cabinet Office CSV for 2026.

name: South Korea
timeAuthority: Public Holidays Act and the Regulation on Public Holidays of Government Offices; temporary holidays by Cabinet decision.

calendarCoverage.note: Only the temporary holiday of 27 January.
Labour Day, Constitution Day and the August/October substitute holidays only; lunar holidays not recorded.

name: Pakistan
timeAuthority: Federal government (Cabinet Division notifications) for public holidays; Central Ruet-e-Hilal Committee for Islamic dates.

calendarCoverage.note: Federal Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha holidays only.

name: Indonesia
timeAuthority: Joint decree (SKB) of the Ministers of Religious Affairs, Manpower and PANRB; Islamic dates fixed by the Minister of Religious Affairs (sidang isbat).

calendarCoverage.note: All 17 national holidays and 8 collective-leave days (cuti bersama, not days off for the general workforce) of SKB 1497/2/5 of 2025, transcribed from the scanned decree.

name: Türkiye
timeAuthority: Law No. 2429 on national and general holidays; Diyanet fixes the Islamic dates by calculation.

calendarCoverage.note: All general holidays under Law 2429 for 2026 are recorded, but Saturday status differs by sector (Law 2429 art. 3: weekly holiday is Sunday, from Saturday 13:00 at the latest), so working-day answers are not claimed.
